classicalSources.chapter: 山海經·東山經·東山經之首
classicalSources.text: 又南三百里，曰泰山，其上多玉，其下多金。有獸焉，其狀如豚而有珠，名曰狪狪，其鳴自訆。環水出焉，東流注於江，其中多水玉。

classicalSources.verification: Independent primary-text transcription, opening 東山經 circuit, 泰山 paragraph. Uses 自詨 rather than 自訆. Translation places the pearl inside the body, while the primary sentence only says 有珠.
Independent primary text confirms 東山經之首, 泰山 between 犲山 and 竹山, 如豚而有珠; uses simplified characters and 自詨.

adaptation: Normalize the existing HIGH input to 1.6m horizontal length and 2048px textures.

Broaden the torso and snout, shorten the muzzle, lower the back and ear tips; preserve four cloven hooves, two ears and one native curled tail. No spur, tusk, forehead pearl or external jewel is added.
Repaint only base-color texture to muted stone grey while preserving dark eyes, nostrils, bristles and hoof detail.
Fresh quadruped skin with heat/proxy/distance fallback support; rigid split-hoof capsules blended into the lower legs; average coincident seam weights before export at 30fps.

Analytic two-bone hoof targets: four-beat 1.6s walk at 0.3m/s, level stance feet; breathing idle and planted 4.6s calling display. Runtime shared createGroundContacts CCD locks stance ankles and sole orientation in world space while following a circle anchored to the current position and heading on each walk entry. Parent integrated QA measured every selected sole vertex across 600 actual runtime frames: maximum displacement 0.018mm and orientation drift below 0.000006rad in stable support intervals, excluding transition boundaries. Paused-render measurements refresh SkinnedMesh.updateMatrixWorld to update attached bindMatrixInverse.
Meshopt and 2048px WebP compression without simplification, flattening or joining. Final geometry retains 49,940 triangles.

Runtime uses actual useGLTF singleton with effect attachment/cleanup; standard alpha watercolor pearl wash and paired synthetic pig call. Internal pearl location, colors, wash and call are labeled artistic interpretations.
Corrected narration regenerated through pipeline/tts/narrate.ts using cosyvoice-v2 / longsanshu, MP3 only.
